discovery.description: Resolve a Pennsylvania business name to one strong registry entity and compare its Department of State creation date with a caller-selected minimum age. Returns established_entity, recent_entity, company_not_found, or human_review. Formation age alone does not establish current good standing, ownership, authority, legitimacy, fraud risk, sanctions status, creditworthiness, or legal compliance.
discovery.resource_description: Determine whether a uniquely resolved Pennsylvania business entity is at least a caller-selected age using Pennsylvania Department of State creation-date evidence. Returns established_entity, recent_entity, company_not_found, or human_review. Formation age is an identity/history signal, not proof of current good standing, ownership, authority, legitimacy, fraud risk, sanctions status, creditworthiness, or legal compliance.

buyer.task: Determine whether a uniquely resolved Pennsylvania business entity is at least a caller-selected age using Pennsylvania Department of State creation-date evidence.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure only independently verified external settled purchases, not HTTP 200 responses, probes or tests.

sources.authority: Pennsylvania Department of State via data.pa.gov
sources.refresh_policy: authoritative source lookup on each paid request, subject to adapter caching behavior
sources.cache_policy: source-specific adapter caching; no new cache introduced by spec

rules: Require strong, unique Pennsylvania business registry identity.
Compare confirmed creation date against minAgeDays using UTC dates; missing or ambiguous evidence triggers review.
formation age is an identity/history signal only
it does not prove current good standing, ownership, authority, legitimacy, fraud risk, sanctions status, creditworthiness, or legal compliance
creation date is taken from Pennsylvania public registry data and may be unavailable for some records

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; payment is not settled.
failure_behavior.payment_unresolved: HTTP 503; retry the same payment authorization.

criteria: Pass existing exact-revision release gate and authoritative source smokes.
Measure non-credit-gated production hosting, failures, refunds and source costs.
Block commercial release until real margin and external demand are independently evidenced.
